newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa's Metlife sets up new fund.
newsitem.headline: South Africa's Metlife sets up new fund.

text.p: South Africa's Metropolitan Life Ltd said on Tuesday it has established a new fund designed to invest in infrastructure development, capacity building and job creation.
The firm said the fund, called Futurebuilder, consisted of an actively managed portfolio with a market value of more than 300 million rand.
It would be similar to a unit trust in that institutions could participate in the fund by buying units at the prevailing market price.
Portfolio manager Asief Mohamed said the fund aimed to achieve a return of at least four percent above the inflation rate.
"Given the many exciting and profitable avenues of investment open to us in the socio-economic development arena, this objective is not unrealistic," he said.
